_comment: Providers are the files whose contents you want to survive compaction. Both below are examples and are disabled, so out of the box this plugin injects nothing — enable one, or write your own. See the README for what each field does.
_threshold_comment: Also off by default. 'at' and each modelLimits entry accept an absolute token count (120000), a percentage ("60%") or a fraction (0.6). Prefer absolutes or per-model limits if you switch between models with very different context windows — see the README.
